parent_objective: audit M1222 negative source mining and choose terminal-boundary, longer-horizon, stronger-source, or synthesis route
blocked_by: M1222 finds action-divergent wrong-history rows but no success or margin degradation
supersedes: immediate training from empty accepted corpus
immediate threshold weakening after negative source mining
invalidates: treating M1222 action-divergent rows as sufficient self-identification or outcome evidence

public_gates: M1223 may audit existing M1222 artifacts only
M1223 must classify the M1222 negative result
M1223 must choose a concrete next route or require branch synthesis
M1223 must not run new source mining or outcome interventions
M1223 must not use private holdout
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run new source mining
do not run outcome intervention gates
do not weaken thresholds after seeing M1222
do not use hidden or oracle actor inputs
do not claim self-identification from action divergence alone

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: classifies M1222 as action-gap-positive outcome-gap-negative and chooses the next route
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process/audit only; no closed-loop, training, promotion, private-holdout, paper-level, recurrent-belief, or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if M1222 artifacts are missing
stop if failure classification is ambiguous
stop if another narrow milestone would exceed synthesis cadence without a branch decision
fallback_plan: route to branch synthesis if M1223 cannot choose a single next research path
route to terminal-boundary relocation if action gaps are source-diverse but outcome gaps are absent
route to stronger cross-family/fault source if current-family scenes are too outcome-insensitive
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1222 closes the current-family normal-success boundary source smoke with no accepted rows

training_stage.stage_objective: audit current-family boundary source negative result
admission_evidence: M1222 has zero margin-threshold or success-drop rows
blocked_shortcuts: do not make paper-level or self-ID claims
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, review, and next manifest
next_stage_criteria: next terminal-boundary, stronger-source, longer-horizon, or synthesis route is selected
threshold weakening and training shortcuts remain blocked

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1223 is an audit of source-mining evidence and must not infer history necessity from action divergence without outcome degradation.
history_necessity_tests: route selection before any outcome gate or training
guards against interpreting action divergence as self-ID
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: Outcome-critical evidence remains blocked until a later route produces real-history margin or success degradation.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Record the negative result and route to terminal-boundary, stronger-source, longer-horizon, or branch synthesis rather than training.
allowed_claims: no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: M1222 is best classified as action-gap-positive but outcome-gap-negative, so the next route should sharpen the outcome boundary or change source distribution before training.
success_criteria: one next route is selected or branch synthesis is required
no outcome intervention, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, profile tuning, or actor-input contract expansion occurs
failure_criteria: new source mining or outcome intervention is run
thresholds are weakened after seeing M1222
action-divergent rows are claimed as self-identification
decision_rule: M1223 passes if it classifies M1222 and selects a concrete next route without running new experiments or weakening thresholds.
